criteria.eligible: A fixed-commit ordinary entry has an exact v0.8.0 selector, a uniquely resolved local path within four edges and a supported Prisma or Drizzle object operation without relying on an excluded mapping.
criteria.excluded: The historical entry remains visible but does not enter the completion denominator when it lacks an object selector/operation or requires an explicit non-goal such as TypeORM, Mongoose, arbitrary validator semantics, external higher-order wrapper semantics or dynamic data-client dispatch.
criteria.evidenceBoundary: Eligibility predicts structural analyzability, not security, vulnerability, runtime reachability, deployed enforcement or production accuracy.

optionalFifthProject.reason: No project was added before the owner decides whether to extend one bounded mapping or use the single optional project slot. Adding an easy project now would hide the current-corpus shortfall.

decisionRequired.statement: The current contract has four eligible paths, two fewer than the six-path floor, and no eligible query-constraint case. D1 must approve a bounded scope adjustment or a fifth grounded project before P2.
decisionRequired.prohibitedResolution: Do not lower the six-path floor, relabel client input as a principal, erase excluded entries or count fixtures as real paths.

claims: This ledger freezes manual expectations before v0.8.0 production analyzer implementation.
It is not a production precision, recall, reachability or exploitability measurement.
Historical v0.7.0 assessments are copied verbatim and remain historical.
